use crate::types::{Error, Failure as ImportedFailure, Outcome as ImportedOutcome, SearchResult, Wrapper};

pub fn cross_file() -> ImportedOutcome<()> { Ok(()) }
pub fn borrowed_success(value: &str) -> ImportedOutcome<&str> { Ok(value) }
pub fn borrowed_error(error: &ImportedFailure) -> Result<(), &ImportedFailure> { Err(error) }
pub fn bounded<E: core::fmt::Display>(error: E) -> Result<(), E> { Err(error) }
pub fn where_bound<E>(error: E) -> Result<(), E> where E: core::fmt::Display { Err(error) }
pub fn unbounded<E>(error: E) -> Result<(), E> { Err(error) }
pub fn debug_only<E: core::fmt::Debug>(error: E) -> Result<(), E> { Err(error) }
pub fn instantiated(error: Wrapper<ImportedFailure>) -> Result<(), Wrapper<ImportedFailure>> { Err(error) }
pub fn conditional_unknown<E>(error: Wrapper<E>) -> Result<(), Wrapper<E>> { Err(error) }
pub fn named_error() -> Result<(), Error> { Ok(()) }
pub fn named_result() -> SearchResult { SearchResult }
pub fn option() -> Option<ImportedFailure> { None }

pub trait Read {
    fn read(&self) -> ImportedOutcome<&str>;
}
pub struct Reader;
impl Read for Reader {
    fn read(&self) -> ImportedOutcome<&str> { Ok("value") }
}
